fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the execution of "sysctl" with specific arguments that have been used by threat actors and malware. It provides system hardware information.
This process is primarily used to detect and avoid virtualization and analysis environments.
fields.name: System Information Discovery Via Sysctl - MacOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/sysctl" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "sysctl") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "hw." or tgt.process.cmdline contains "kern." or tgt.process.cmdline contains "machdep.")))
